doc: How the situational layer reaches existing EdgeDesk models. OFF: the adapter returns nothing and every consumer behaves exactly as before. SHADOW (default): the adapter returns a labelled block beside the existing output with applied_points 0 — what the layer WOULD change, attributed, and nothing changed. ACTIVE: refused unless all three locks are open — (1) research/promotion.json records an APPROVED integration study for this target, signed by a person; (2) points_applied below is true; (3) mode is ACTIVE. No file in this repository sets (1): promotion is a person's act after a preregistered integration study, separate from the volume-model holdout. Rollback: set every mode to OFF (or SHADOW) and commit; nothing else moves.

nfl_simulator.consumer: football/situational/simulator_shadow.js over the NFL simulator's input contract
